sovereign_country.strategic_role: 极速离岸证券与外汇交易商持牌（VFSC）、轻资产免税出海

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Cold-Chain Keg Wholesale and Export of Artisanal Hazy IPAs

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Vanuatu (International Companies regime, VFSC, Port Vila)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid Legal System: English Common Law foundation, French Civil Law influence, and customary 'kastom' law; codified under the Constitution of Vanuatu (1980); statutes include the International Companies Act [Cap 222]
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: PACER-Plus (Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus, in force 13 December 2020)
No comprehensive double tax agreement network in force as of assessment date; limited bilateral investment treaty coverage; reliance on non-treaty tax-exempt status of International Companies

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act [Cap 222] as amended (including beneficial ownership verification duties for VFSC-licensed registered agents); Financial Transactions Reporting Act No. 18 of 2000 as amended; Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) Directions; VFSC AML/CFT Rulebook for Registered Agents (2020); Vanuatu Financial Services Commission Act No. 10 of 1993 as amended

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified notarized copy of the valid passport of each individual UBO, director, and corporate officer
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent national passport authority of the country of issuance; notarization by a licensed public notary in the country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (Vanuatu is not a party to the Hague Apostille Convention; documents must be legalized by the Vanuatu Ministry of Foreign Affairs and, where required, the destination consulate)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized proof of residential address (recent utility bill or bank statement) for each UBO and director
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider or licensed financial institution in the country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (as above; alternatively accepted as certified copies by the VFSC-licensed registered agent under its AML/CFT policy)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter and source-of-funds confirmation for each UBO and corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing bank holding the beneficial owner's or shareholder's primary account
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization where cross-border reliance is required; otherwise direct secure transmission to the registered agent

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association and Certificate of Good Standing (post-incorporation documents required for opening Swift Wire-enabled banking accounts and origin-country licensing)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (attestation by the Vanuatu Ministry of Foreign Affairs and consular certification of the destination jurisdiction)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, directors, officers, signatories, and material counterparties against the UN Consolidated Security Council Sanctions List, FATF Public Statements and grey-list measures, OFAC SDN List, and Vanuatu FIU domestic watchlists; politically exposed persons (PEPs) and family/close associates are subject to enhanced due diligence including verified source-of-funds and source-of-wealth evidence; for the craft beer distribution scope, negative news and adverse media checks are applied to all export market counterparties and cold-chain logistics providers; screening is conducted at onboarding and continuously at 90-day intervals under the VFSC AML/CFT Rulebook.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) – Companies Office, Rue de Paris, Port Vila; online name availability search and reservation via the VFSC Company Search Portal
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Official languages are Bislama, English, and French; proposed names must use Latin script (Bislama and English already deploy the Latin alphabet) and French diacritics are permitted; no separate transliteration is required; the name must conclude with a statutory suffix such as 'Limited', 'Ltd', 'Corporation', 'Corp', 'Incorporated', 'Inc.', or 'Société Anonyme' (SA); the submitted craft beer distribution name must include an ISIC-relevant descriptive element (e.g., 'Craft Beer Distribution') for regulatory clarity.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the applicant has 14 calendar days to file a written administrative appeal with the VFSC Registrar of Companies stating the legal and factual grounds, the corrected proposed name, and payment of the prescribed appeal fee (approximately VUV 10,000); the Registrar must issue a reasoned decision within 7 business days; alternatively, the applicant may immediately submit a fresh name reservation excluding the refused token; if the appeal is denied, the applicant may pursue judicial review in the Vanuatu Supreme Court under the Judicial Review Act, though market practice favors resubmission with a revised name to avoid delay.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Accepted. An International Company must maintain a registered office in Vanuatu at the physical address of a VFSC-licensed registered agent; shared or virtual administrative addresses are the market standard for ICs; however, because the business scope requires cold-chain keg wholesale and export of artisanal beer, the IC should hold or lease a physical cold-chain depot in the goods-origin jurisdiction (outside Vanuatu) and reflect that address on commercial invoices, bills of lading, and customs declarations to evidence genuine commercial substance; a purely virtual shell with no operational footprint will trigger heightened bank and correspondent screening.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low to moderate: estimated 15% probability of an unannounced inspection directed at the IC itself, primarily where the registered agent is under regulatory review; the VFSC and FIU may conduct on-site inspections of the VFSC-licensed registered agent on a 20–25% annual audit cycle; origin-country alcohol regulators and customs authorities may perform periodic physical checks of the cold-chain distribution premises, which are contractually foreseeable.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Courier, certified English/French translation, and document reproduction
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed courier and certified translation service
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market rate for international express courier and per-page certified translation

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act [Cap 222] of Vanuatu, as amended, particularly sections 3, 6, 7, 8, 18, 25 and 119; supplemented by the International Companies Regulations 1993 (as amended)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of Companies, Companies and International Trusts Registry, Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Port Vila
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Form 1 – Application for Incorporation, together with the Memorandum of Association and Articles of Association filed under the International Companies Act [Cap 222]
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital and no escrow account requirement; the International Company must have at least one issued share, which may be a no-par-value share, with authorised capital as stated in the Memorandum of Association
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that upon receipt of the Certificate of Incorporation of the Company, the Memorandum and Articles of Association as subscribed are adopted in final form. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the registered office of the Company be established at the address of the licensed registered agent in Port Vila, Vanuatu. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the issue and allotment of one fully paid subscriber share to the founding shareholder is approved and entered into the register of members. RESOLVED FURTHER, that [Name] is appointed a director and [Name] is appointed secretary, each with authority to execute banking mandates and file all VFSC returns. RESOLVED FINALLY, that the officers are authorised to pursue the permits required for craft-brewery distribution and to open the corporate bank account pending completion of licensing.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name reservation and due diligence clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Companies Registry via licensed international registered agent (online company search and e-services portal)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation request through the licensed agent; confirm the proposed company name does not contain restricted terms such as 'bank', 'trust', 'insurance' or 'assurance' without a functional licence; obtain VFSC availability clearance in writing.
required_dossiers: Memorandum of Association draft containing proposed company name
Pre-incorporation consent resolution of intending subscribers
Identity and due-diligence file of each subscriber (certified passport and proof of address)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Resubmit a revised name application with an alternative name; if the name is queried for distinctiveness, attach a notarised explanatory letter and any trade-mark evidence.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation of constitution and subscriber consents
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association in the prescribed statutory form, including authorised share capital, no-par share provisions, director and secretary powers, indemnity clauses and election to be an international company; arrange execution of the subscription clause by the first shareholder by counterpart signatures.
required_dossiers: Memorandum of Association (ICA Cap 222, s.6)
Articles of Association (ICA Cap 222, s.7)
Written consents of the first director and the first secretary
Certified copy of each subscriber's passport and utility bill
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Amend and restate the draft constitution via written board consent; if notarisation or apostille is rejected, re-execute signatures before a Vanuatu notary public and resubmit.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of Form 1 and payment of incorporation fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Companies, Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File Form 1 (Application for Incorporation) through the licensed registered agent, together with the completed constitution documents; pay the government filing fee of approximately USD 250 by wire or agent-settled VFSC account, and elect standard or expedited processing.
required_dossiers: Form 1 – Application for Incorporation
Memorandum and Articles of Association
Licensed registered agent's endorsement certificate
Proof of payment of the incorporation filing fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Cure any formal defect within 14 days of the VFSC query notice; re-file an amended Form 1 with an explanatory letter and pay any reactivation fee if the application lapses.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of certificate of incorporation and share register adoption
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon satisfaction of section 8 of the International Companies Act, the Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation; the registered agent then creates the Register of Members, records the subscriber share allotment, and prepares the share certificate issued under the corporate seal.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation issued by VFSC
Register of Members
Register of Directors and Secretaries
Share certificate executed under the company seal
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Apply to VFSC for a certified copy or Certificate of Good Standing; if the certificate contains clerical errors, file a written request to the Registrar for administrative rectification.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Establishment of registered office and agent appointment
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC Companies Registry and licensed registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Ensure the registered office is located at the licensed agent's address in Port Vila; execute the registered agent agreement; file any notice of change of registered office under section 18 of the ICA and record the agent's consent to receive service of process.
required_dossiers: Registered office consent letter from the agent
Registered agent service agreement
Notice of registered office address (ICA Cap 222, s.18)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: The agent files a corrective notice with VFSC without additional fee if the original address notice is defective; confirm the corrected address on the VFSC public register.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-incorporation organisation and corporate bank onboarding
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC for statutory returns; Vanuatu licenced banks and AML/CFT Compliance Unit for account opening
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the First Board Resolution, adopt the corporate seal, open the corporate bank account with SWIFT wire and local direct debit rails, and complete the beneficial-ownership and source-of-funds declarations; retain the International Company's automatic exemption from the Business Licence while pursuing industrial and excise permits.
required_dossiers: Minutes of the First Board Resolution
Certificate of Incumbency issued by VFSC or the registered agent
Registered agent's consent to continuing statutory obligations
Bank account opening forms, board resolution designating bank signatories, and beneficial-ownership declaration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Re-submit corporate records with certified English translation and a VFSC Certificate of Good Standing if the bank requests supplementary evidence; liaise with the bank's AML Compliance Officer to resolve any beneficial-ownership clarification.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Department of Industry, Ministry of Trade, Tourism, Industry and Commerce (MTTIC), Vanuatu
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Manufacturing Business Licence and Alcoholic Beverage Manufacturing Excise Licence issued by the Vanuatu Customs and Inland Revenue Service (VACIS)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Ministry of Climate Change Adaptation, Meteorology and Geo-Hazards
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 2 – Preliminary Environmental Assessment (screening tier under the Environmental Management and Conservation Act [Cap 283]); a full EIA is not required for small-capacity microbrewery operations unless located within a sensitive water-catchment area
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Industrial wastewater discharge must meet the Vanuatu national effluent quality guidelines for organic load (BOD/COD), total suspended solids and pH; fermentation and keg-cleaning VOC emissions must remain within workplace occupational exposure limits; spent grain, yeast and diatomaceous earth must be handled as industrial waste under the Waste Management Act No. 24 of 2002

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification from the Vanuatu Fire and Emergency Services covering brewery process risk, means of escape and suppression systems; structural load inspection by the Department of Public Works for cold-storage and keg-cellar floor loads; occupational health and safety clearance from the Occupational Health and Safety Unit, Ministry of Labour, covering PPE, confined-space entry, refrigerant handling and noise monitoring.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Revenue and Customs (VRC), Ministry of Finance and Economic Management, Port Vila, Vanuatu; official e-services portal: https://vrc.gov.vu
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign investor organizing as a Vanuatu International Company (IC) must procure its statutory tax identifier through the following SOP: (1) appointment of a VFSC-licensed registered agent and lodgement of incorporation documents under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222]; (2) issuance by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission of the Certificate of Incorporation and IC registration number, together with a tax exemption certificate confirming the entity's exempt status; (3) where the IC will make taxable supplies in or into Vanuatu, submission of Form VAT Reg-001 to the Vanuatu Revenue and Customs with the IC certificate, registered agent's certificate, board resolution, beneficial ownership particulars and projected turnover; (4) issuance by VRC of a Taxpayer Identification Number / VAT Registration Number; and (5) for import-export operations, application for a Customs Importer/Exporter code. No national income tax TIN or employer tax registration is required because Vanuatu has no corporate income tax or PAYE on non-resident employees.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box election exists under Vanuatu law. An International Company is statutorily classified as a non-resident, tax-exempt entity without the need for any entity-level election. No hybrid mismatch election, branch registration, or classification election is prescribed. If the IC engages in a domestic VAT-triggering activity, it may elect to register for VAT voluntarily (subject to VRC approval); however this election affects VAT treatment only and does not alter the entity-level income-tax exemption. The Minister of Finance may issue a tax-exemption certificate in connection with contract lender due diligence.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under the Value Added Tax Act [Cap. 245] (as amended), administered by Vanuatu Revenue and Customs (VRC)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VUV 2,000,000 (approx. USD 17,000) of annual taxable supplies in any consecutive 12-month period; voluntary registration is permitted below the threshold. A non-resident IC is not required to register merely because it earns foreign-source income, but an economic nexus arises if it supplies goods to customers in Vanuatu (including online sales) or imports goods/equipment into Vanuatu, as VAT is chargeable at importation regardless of turnover.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No mandatory electronic invoicing, continuous transaction controls (CTC), government-licensed clearance gateway, API filing, or digital stamping regime is currently in operation. VRC accepts paper-based VAT returns and invoices generated by standard accounting software, provided each registered supplier issues sequentially numbered tax invoices and keeps the audit trail. The VRC maintains electronic risk-based verification for exports, but there is no real-time fiscal clearance or oil-tax/GST dashboard that must be integrated as of the current assessment period.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating is available for a registered supplier's direct export of physical goods (including beer/kegs) from Vanuatu to a non-resident purchaser, provided the goods are consigned out of Vanuatu and exported within the period stipulated by VAT regulations or contracts. Offshore services are zero-rated when supplied to a non-resident and wholly consumed/used outside Vanuatu; international freight and transport services also qualify. The exporter must be a VRC-registered supplier, maintain credible evidence of the export (not merely intra-island carriage), and obtain banking evidence of payment in foreign or VUV currency from the non-resident buyer. On-shipment to Vanuatu consumers, abandoned cargo, or export that later re-enters Vanuatu does not qualify for zero-rating.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Cus. Exp.) validated by the Vanuatu Customs desk officer
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill showing consignor/exporter name and foreign destination
Inward Remittance Certificate (IRC) issued by a licensed Vanuatu bank or SWIFT MT103 credit evidence
Commercial invoice and packing list reconciling line items, keg count, batch numbers, and declared export value
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: VRC export and refund controls are strict: zero-rating is provisional until all export documentation is produced and the sale proceeds are repatriated through a Vanuatu licensed bank within 180 days from the shipment date. If that deadline is missed, or if declarations are false, VRC will disallow the export and claim all VAT at 12.5% on the original invoice, reverse any input VAT refunds already paid, and add statutory interest and default penalties. A knowingly fraudulent export zero-rating claim is a criminal offence under the Value Added Tax Act and Customs Act, exposing the entity to fines up to VUV 1,000,000 (or such higher amount as the variance penalty rules provide) and imprisonment of officers; management also risks cancellation of the IC registration and blacklisting from future customs clearance. Proof of currency repatriation and custody of export evidence must be maintained for at least seven years.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV) — sole monetary authority and banking supervisor under the Financial Institutions Act and the International Banking Act. No separate foreign exchange administration exists; the VFSC separately licenses International Companies. Vanuatu is an IMF Article VIII member and applies no exchange-control approval regime.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The VUV is freely convertible for both current and capital transactions; there are no exchange controls on dividends, capital repatriation, or loan servicing. A Vanuatu International Company under the International Companies Act [Cap 222] may hold and remit funds in any currency without RBV approval. The only remittance hurdle is commercial bank source-of-funds and UBO due diligence; there is no regulatory conversion licensing, no profit remittance quota, and no tax clearance prerequisite for outbound transfers.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None. The IC may retain 100% of cold-chain beverage export proceeds indefinitely in USD, AUD, or NZD accounts; there is no statutory conversion timeline, no mandatory conversion ratio, and no requirement to declare export contracts or shipping documents to the RBV or Customs.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of South Pacific (BSP) Vanuatu Limited

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low. Vanuatu ICs are generally unsupported by offshore digital EMIs (Wise, Airwallex, Revolut Business) due to the absence of a machine-readable VFSC registry validation channel, entity-type AML profiling, and the fact that the VFSC does not license or recognise standalone EMI authorisation under the International Banking Act. Core treasury must run through tier-1 SWIFT-connected banks; EMIs, where available, are limited to destination-market collection facilitation via locally incorporated paying agents.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: No statutory physical attendance mandate. ANZ and BSP permit remote onboarding of International Companies, subject to a mandatory video-conference KYC interview with each authorised signatory and the ultimate beneficial owner, plus notarised and apostilled corporate documents. BRED allows fully remote onboarding but applies Group BPCE extraterritorial KYC standards. NBV is most conservative and generally requires a resident introducer or in-branch appearance. A Certified True Copy of the Certificate of Incorporation, Register of Directors, Register of Shareholders, and a UBO declaration are uniformly required.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: UBO opacity arising from nominee shareholder or discretionary trust layers at or above the 25% threshold
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Apostilled declaration of trust listing named beneficiaries; complete chain-of-title Register of Shareholders; UBO organogram with passport copies of all natural-person principals; source-of-wealth statement supported by audited financials or bank reference; VFSC-registered agent attestation confirming International Companies Act compliance.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sectoral red flags associated with alcoholic-beverage wholesale and export (perceived sanctions, brand counterfeiting, or duty-evasion adjacency)
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Valid wholesale and import distribution licences for each destination market; executed brewery supply agreements; invoice-matched packing lists and bills of lading per shipment; cold-chain logistics contracts evidencing physical goods flow; customs export declarations; transactional profile letter from counsel describing the invoice-backed, arms-length trade cycle.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-velocity USD SWIFT flows via Hong Kong or Singapore transit accounts before final settlement in Australia or New Zealand
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Rolling 12-month treasury forecast and cash-conversion-cycle memo; signed purchase orders matched to outbound payments; marine and cargo insurance certificates; existing relationship-manager reference from the home bank; monthly reconciliation statements evidencing alignment of payment amounts with commercial invoices.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Shareholder capital and subordinated loans are injected via SWIFT MT103 from the investor's home jurisdiction into the IC's designated USD or AUD operational account at ANZ or BSP. Wire remarks must state the beneficiary reference 'VU_IC_ISIC_4632' and cite 'capital subscription under International Companies Act [Cap 222]'. No RBV approval, exchange-control form, or tax clearance is required. The receiving bank requires a board resolution authorising account opening and the capital subscription agreement for source-of-funds sign-off. Inward wires above approximately VUV 30 million (~USD 250,000) attract standard enhanced due diligence, not a regulatory ceiling. The IC must not receive domestic VUV trade receivables from Vanuatu residents due to the non-resident trading prohibition; local direct-debit collections must be executed by onshore distribution agents in the destination market.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Brewery payments, freight, and cold-chain logistics are settled via (i) SWIFT MT103 (gpi-tracked) for open-account invoice payments; (ii) SWIFT MT700 documentary letters of credit for high-value brewery purchase contracts; and (iii) MT101/MT940 liquidity-sweep instructions for internal treasury concentration. Each outbound instruction cites the commercial invoice number, Incoterm, and purchase-order reference. No stamp duty, remittance tax, or withholding applies to outbound wires from Vanuatu ICs. AUD/NZD legs settle same-day via CLS-participating correspondent networks at ANZ (Australia) and BSP (Australia/PNG).
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: USD/VUV Non-Deliverable Forwards (NDFs) executed OTC through ANZ or BSP offshore desks using the WM/Reuters VUV fixing — the primary hedge given limited deliverability of VUV offshore.
USD/AUD and USD/NZD deliverable forwards via Australian and New Zealand correspondent banks, matched to brewery procurement and cold-chain freight exposure.
Cross-currency interest rate swaps (USD vs AUD/NZD) for long-term multi-currency brewery off-take payment streams.
Vanilla FX spot contracts — unrestricted, same-day value, with no RBV reporting threshold.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return (Form AR-IC) and payment of annual renewal fee for an International Company
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), International Companies Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within one calendar month after each anniversary of the date of incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing surcharge of 10% per month or part-month on the unpaid annual fee; administrative strike-off after six months of arrears; struck-off entity is dissolved and directors may be disqualified for two years under VFSC practice.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual beneficial ownership (UBO) declaration filed by the licensed registered agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) via the licensed registered agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Same anniversary filing window as the Annual Return; must be updated within 14 days of any change in ultimate beneficial ownership
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to maintain or submit UBO information attracts fines under the International Companies Act and AML/CFT regulations; VFSC may impose a VT 50,000 penalty and suspend the registered agent's licence for repeat non-compliance.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Business licence annual renewal (only if the International Company carries on any physical, sales, or warehousing activity within Vanuatu)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Ministry of Finance, Business Licence Office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Calendar-year licence expiring 31 December; renewal due by 31 January of the following year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: 50% surcharge on the licence fee after 31 March; continued unlicensed operation is an offence punishable by fines up to VT 200,000 and potential closure of the local premises. Offshore-only distribution and export outside Vanuatu normally falls outside this licensing requirement.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory independent audit is required for a Vanuatu International Company; audit applies only if the entity holds a VFSC-regulated licence (e.g., banking, insurance, securities dealer), which is not the case for craft beer distribution. Preparation of unaudited financial statements for the agent and shareholders is sufficient.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) or simplified Vanuatu-recognised equivalent; the International Companies Act requires accounting records sufficient to accurately explain transactions and enable financial position to be determined with reasonable accuracy.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The registered agent must hold current beneficial ownership data on file and lodge an annual declaration to VFSC at each incorporation anniversary. Any share transfer resulting in a new or differed beneficial owner is recorded in the Register of Members and reported to VFSC within 14 days; all UBO records must be retained for at least seven years after the relationship ends.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Minute Book (resolutions and minutes of meetings, held by the registered agent)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 2,000 – 4,000 per annum, only if the board voluntarily commissions certified financial statements

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% (Vanuatu does not impose corporate income tax at the national level; a Vanuatu International Company is taxed at nil on its worldwide income, subject only to VFSC annual fees).
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No corporate income tax, capital gains tax, branch profits tax, or dividend withholding tax applies. An International Company licensed under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222] is expressly exempt from all Vanuatu income taxes. Value Added Tax at 12.5% applies only to local taxable supplies in Vanuatu; offshore craft beer wholesale and export distribution is outside the domestic VAT net, although VAT registration may be triggered by incidental local supplies if the statutory threshold is crossed. The annual economic burden is limited to the VFSC maintenance fee and registered agent compliance fee.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Vanuatu has no corporate income tax return. The sole statutory annual filing for an International Company is the VFSC Annual Return filed through a licensed Vanuatu registered agent using the VFSC electronic registry portal; the relevant form is the Registered Agent Annual Return / Licence Renewal Declaration under Section 112 of the International Companies Act [Cap. 222].
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The annual return is due within 30 calendar days after each anniversary of incorporation; if the anniversary falls on a weekend or public holiday, the filing is accepted on the next business day.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full legal name of the International Company.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the exact name appearing on the certificate of incorporation; do not insert a trading name or craft beer brand name unless separately registered.
Insert the registration number in the prescribed format, e.g., IC-XXXX; all leading zeros and suffixes must be reproduced exactly as issued by VFSC.
Provide the physical address maintained by the licensed registered agent in Port Vila or Luganville; an offshore mailing address or brewery head office is not acceptable.

List each director, including nominee and foreign-resident directors, with full name, nationality, passport number, and residential address; indicate any nominee capacity and confirm a valid consent in writing exists.

Disclose registered shareholders and, where shares are held through a trust or holding company, identify the ultimate beneficial owner; non-resident entities must supply the underlying corporate structure chart and source of funds.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of offshore status and prohibited activities.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Tick the declaration that the company is an International Company and has not carried on business with Vanuatu residents, has not held land in Vanuatu, and has not conducted unlicensed banking, insurance, or trust business; confirm all craft beer distribution contracts are with non-residents.

The form must be certified by a licensed registered agent; if an offshore director signs, attach a notarised or apostilled signature page and maintain an original executed copy at the registered office.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing triggers a late fee equal to 10% of the annual licence fee, plus an additional 10% after one month of continued default. VFSC may impose an administrative penalty of up to VUV 1,000,000, with a daily default surcharge of VUV 10,000, and may suspend or strike off the company after continued non-compliance; directors in default may be subject to daily fines and disqualification.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0%; Vanuatu does not levy dividend withholding tax, secondary corporate tax, or branch remittance tax on a Vanuatu International Company.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Vanuatu has not concluded comprehensive double taxation agreements; it maintains only targeted tax information exchange agreements and exchange-of-information arrangements. The DTA relief mechanism and tax residence certificate procedure are therefore not applicable to Vanuatu-source dividends. An International Company may pay dividends to any non-resident shareholder without obtaining a Vanuatu TRC and without notifying the VFSC. The company must still pass a board resolution, satisfy the solvency test under the International Companies Act, and record the distribution as a reduction of reserves or share premium.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory withholding tax on cross-border royalties and debt interest is 0%; because Vanuatu has no double tax treaties, treaty-reduced rates are likewise unavailable. Royalties for craft beer trademarks, franchise formulas, and intercompany loan interest may be remitted to foreign recipients free of Vanuatu withholding tax. However, the higher tax jurisdiction of the recipient may assert its own source taxation, transfer pricing, or CFC rules against excessive royalty or interest payments.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: VUV 0 statutory threshold because Vanuatu has no corporate income tax and therefore no domestic transfer pricing documentation obligation. For good governance and foreign tax defence, contemporaneous documentation should be prepared when annual related-party transactions involving craft beer distribution, keg leasing, logistics, or brand royalties exceed VUV 50,000,000; the OECD-aligned Local File and Master File are recommended where group revenue exceeds USD 50,000,000.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Applicable. The VFSC Economic Substance Regulations require a Vanuatu International Company carrying on a relevant activity, including distribution and service centre business, to demonstrate economic substance in Vanuatu. A craft beer wholesale and export entity must maintain its principal place of business in Vanuatu through a physical registered office and adequate staff presence, keep books and records locally, ensure core income-generating activities such as contract negotiation, order management, inventory control, shipping arrangements, and invoicing are conducted from Vanuatu, and file an annual economic substance return. A broad self-declaration of no activity will be insufficient if the company is earning distribution and commission income; failure to satisfy the substance test exposes the company and directors to fines, strike-off, and international regulatory adverse action.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion / Profit Repatriation Abuse Through Zero-Rate Jurisdiction
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The Vanuatu International Company books a high-margin distribution commission on craft beer sales sourced from a related brewery in a high-tax country while maintaining no employees, no warehouse, no keg logistics, and no locally verifiable order-processing data in Vanuatu; the shifted profits are immediately distributed to a foreign parent without economic substance or commercial rationale.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Vanuatu-side penalties include a VFSC economic substance administrative penalty of up to VUV 5,000,000, a daily continuing default penalty of VUV 100,000, licence revocation, and strike-off from the register. In the foreign shareholder's jurisdiction, tax authorities may reallocate profit under controlled foreign corporation and transfer pricing rules, impose underpayment interest, and apply penalty taxes of up to 100% of the additional assessment.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign false declarations or approve the artificial distribution may be jointly and severally liable for civil restitution of diverted corporate funds; courts may issue asset freezes, travel bans, disqualification orders, and, where fraudulent evasion is shown, imprisonment of up to seven years in the jurisdiction asserting criminal tax fraud.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Use of nominee directors, bare registered-agent addresses, no local board meetings, no locally engaged employees, and annual returns that deny any business activity while the company in fact operates an active cross-border craft beer distribution business with substantial invoice turnover.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: A false economic substance declaration constitutes an offence under the VFSC Economic Substance regime; penalties escalate from a first-offence fine of VUV 2,500,000 to a second-offence fine of VUV 5,000,000, with a daily non-compliance surcharge of VUV 50,000. VFSC may order compulsory strike-off and public naming of the company on the compliance default list.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Every director and signatory of the false return is personally liable for the outstanding penalty if the company does not pay it, and each responsible officer may be fined up to VUV 1,000,000 and imprisoned for up to five years; nominee directors cannot rely on contractual indemnities to avoid criminal sanctions.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML / CFT Breach in Craft Beer Export Receivables
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The International Company receives structured wire transfers or digital payments for keg exports split into amounts below foreign reporting thresholds, transacts with unexplained counterparties, fails to maintain beneficial ownership records, or omits source-of-wealth evidence for large capital contributions used to fund brewery operations.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Vanuatu AML/CFT framework, failure to comply with beneficial ownership, record-keeping, and suspicious transaction reporting obligations is punishable by a fine of up to VUV 10,000,000 and imprisonment of up to 10 years for the company and responsible officers; VFSC may suspend or revoke the International Company licence and make the company's accounts subject to a confiscation order.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and compliance officers are personally exposed to criminal money-laundering liability of up to 15 years' imprisonment and civil liability for traceable proceeds; courts may issue urgent travel bans, freezing orders, and worldwide asset seizure against directors, and any bankruptcy arising from forfeiture may cause personal disqualification from managing Vanuatu or foreign companies.
